statement: Lambda lists NVIDIA B200 SXM6 on-demand cloud capacity at $6.69 per GPU per hour for 8x instances
why: This is a published rental level for current-generation accelerators with no stated prior price, so it is a static level for the pricing overlay only.

impact.mechanism: Published on-demand rental levels describe where accelerator rental pricing sits today; with no baseline they carry no directional information.

confidence.basis: Vendor's own public pricing page observed directly, but a single secondary source and a list price rather than transacted price.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 2.79 -> 6.69 (tol 1%); sources: Lambda (Lambda Labs)
